findings.subject: Sun Pyramid cave, Teotihuacan
findings.assertion: Two superposed fire features in Area C:East layer 4 BYCT are separated by approximately 10 cm of intervening BYCT sediment, demonstrating at least two burning episodes rather than one continuous fire.
evidence_locators: Sload (2020) chapter 7, Area C East / Blockage 11, printed p.111 vicinity, fig.5.2a; Sload cites Altschul 1978a:113
findings.uncertainty: Original interval unknown; Altschul field notes not independently inspected

findings.subject: Sun Pyramid cave, Teotihuacan
findings.assertion: Excavators recorded a series of deliberately placed small rocks in Layer 5 fill at about 25, 43 and 60 cm depths, with sample Beta-220754 near the deepest group and associated with a Tzacualli polished jar sherd (SF54) and calcium-carbonate ring (SF55).
evidence_locators: Sload (2020) chapter 7, Area C East, printed p.104; cites Altschul 1978a:115,118
findings.uncertainty: Rocks as boundary-markers is interpretive; charcoal date does not date placement directly

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: Radio UNAM preserved 17 reel-to-reel tapes of the student-produced 1968 news program El movimiento estudiantil informa, whose episodes averaged approximately 20 minutes.
findings.uncertainty: Original tapes were not listened to; institutional report only

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: According to UNAM reporting, student-produced broadcasts documented the police clearance of the Zócalo on August 28, 1968, including allegations of severe injuries and deaths.
findings.uncertainty: Allegations in broadcast must be attributed; casualty counts not independently verified

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: UNAM reports that a student broadcast recorded the October 5, 1968 press conference at Ciudad Universitaria, where students renewed their demand for dialogue on the six-point petition.
evidence_locators: Gaceta UNAM, Frías (2019), Contenidos, final paragraph

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: In its December 1968 manifesto, the CNH characterized its six-point petition and demand for public dialogue as a challenge to the political structure, demanding open discussion rather than confidential settlement.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML, paragraphs beginning El carácter antidemocrático; La ausencia de actitudes críticas; Al responder a las arbitrariedades
findings.uncertainty: Edited transcription only; original El Día newsprint not inspected

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The CNH December manifesto described school student assemblies and the full CNH plenary as the movement’s sovereign decision-making organs, with participating schools represented through those bodies.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML paragraphs beginning El Consejo Nacional de Huelga; El Consejo Nacional de Huelga ha demandado
findings.uncertainty: Movement self-description; verify with archival meeting records

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The CNH publicly denied that it represented a homogeneous political ideology; it said it brought together political currents cooperating around democratic rights and the Mexican Constitution.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML paragraph beginning El Consejo Nacional de Huelga, máxima expresión

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The CNH December manifesto singled out Demetrio Vallejo and Valentín Campa by name as political prisoners and linked the call for their release to detentions of 1968 demonstrators.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML paragraphs beginning Hemos demandado la libertad de los presos políticos; Y son presos políticos
findings.uncertainty: Primary movement position via edited transcript; confirm original copy

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The CNH manifesto reported that students undertook political brigades in working-class neighborhoods and factories, naming Topilejo as an encounter with social and community problems beyond university campuses.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML paragraphs beginning Ha demostrado que en México; En las colonias proletarias; Por otra parte, en las brigadas
findings.uncertainty: Movement self-report, not independent evidence of each visit

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The CNH manifesto acknowledged a tactical return to classes despite unmet demands, explaining that protecting the institutional autonomy and continued democratic structures of UNAM and IPN had become an immediate priority.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML paragraphs beginning Estos triunfos parciales; Se ha acusado a los estudiantes de intransigentes
findings.uncertainty: Official declaration, not proof all participants agreed

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The December manifesto proposed extending the movement beyond students by organizing with productive sectors in both urban and rural Mexico.
evidence_locators: Edited HTML paragraphs beginning Las perspectivas que se ofrecen al movimiento; Los estudiantes nos aliaremos
findings.uncertainty: Declared intention, not evidence proposal implemented

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: The Archivo General de la Nación dates the release of railroad labor leader Demetrio Vallejo from Lecumberri prison to 29 July 1970; a December 1968 document cannot truthfully state that Vallejo had already been assassinated.
evidence_locators: AGN historical article closing paragraphs beginning Finalmente, el combatiente obrero Demetrio Vallejo
findings.uncertainty: AGN institutional historical account; prison file not directly inspected

findings.subject: Mexico City 1968 student movement and civic politics
findings.assertion: FICUNAM catalogs a 1968 series of four short films produced with still photographs and audio recordings of public student statements, with Paul Leduc, Rafael Castanedo, Óscar Menéndez and others credited as makers.
evidence_locators: FICUNAM Comunicados del Consejo Nacional de Huelga, film metadata and Sinopsis Español
findings.uncertainty: Catalogue only; no footage inspected or rights cleared
